title: Register extract (triodian.aua.extract.v1)
description: The AI Use Assessment register reduced to authority, consequence and evidence for each entry, for AI Risk Appetite's decision 3 check (K10). Written by use-assessment public/aua.js registerExtract(). Superseded by v2, the in-use feed; AI Risk Appetite still accepts v1.

schema.description: Format and version of this file

calibration.description: The calibration the register was measured against, e.g. 'approved v2' or 'uncalibrated'

entries.description: One line per register entry: no names and no provider details
